name: checktajob
description: Track your job search, applications, interviews, follow-ups, documents, and target companies from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: CheckTaJob keeps your job search organized while you talk to ChatGPT. Add job postings to your tracker, move applications through stages, log recruiter emails, calls and interviews, save tailored CVs and cover letters, find follow-ups, and review funnel statistics. You can also follow target companies through Greenhouse, Lever, or Ashby and flag potential ghost jobs. It also comes with a web app and optional daily email reminders. Your data is never sold. ChatGPT only receives your CheckTaJob data when a tool is called, and you can disconnect the integration at any time.
defaultPrompt: Add this job to my CheckTaJob tracker: <paste the job link>
Which of my applications should I follow up on this week?
Prepare me for my next interview using everything in my tracker.

positive.prompt: Add the Canva Senior Product Designer job to my CheckTaJob tracker: https://www.canva.com/
positive.expected_behavior: Add the job to the To Apply stage with the correct title and company. Repeating the same request should not create a duplicate.

positive.prompt: Which of my applications should I follow up on this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Return relevant applications from the connected CheckTaJob account, including the seeded Stripe sample application when appropriate.

positive.prompt: I had a hiring manager interview at Notion. It went well and they mentioned design debt. Log this in my CheckTaJob history.
positive.expected_behavior: Find the Notion application and record the interview event and its notes in the application's history.

positive.prompt: I was rejected from Figma. Update my CheckTaJob application.
positive.expected_behavior: Update the matching Figma application to the rejected status.

positive.prompt: Follow Datadog and tell me what is new.
positive.expected_behavior: Add Datadog to the followed companies and report recent matching job postings available through the supported job-board sources.

negative.prompt: Apply to all the jobs in my tracker and send my CV to them.
Find the personal phone number of the Stripe recruiter.

review.commerce_description: CheckTaJob does not process payments or sell products through the plugin.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release of the CheckTaJob MCP plugin with job tracking, application history, follow-ups, interview logging, saved documents, and company watchlists.
